tdee.title: TDEE calculator
tdee.intro: A formula-based starting point. Once you have logged meals and weight for a couple of weeks, the app works out your real expenditure and this number moves to second place.
tdee.dataHint: Change them here to try scenarios: they only live on this screen and never touch your profile. To change them for real, go to Settings.

activityDescription.sedentary: Seated work and little else: no structured exercise.
activityDescription.light: Easy exercise 1-3 days a week, or a job on your feet.
activityDescription.moderate: Training 3-5 days a week, or plenty of daily movement.
activityDescription.active: Hard training 6-7 days a week, or physical work.
activityDescription.very_active: Hard physical work plus daily training, or two-a-days.

tdee.incomplete: Fill in weight, height and age to see the estimate.
tdee.adaptiveBody: That number comes from your real intake and weight, not a population formula: when it exists, it wins.
tdee.adaptiveLow: Still warming up: the measured number is still settling.
tdee.adaptiveMedium: Medium confidence: the measured number is still being refined.
tdee.noAdaptive: There is no measured TDEE yet. After a couple of weeks of logging, the app will work out yours and this one moves to second place.
tdee.apply: Use {{n, number}} kcal as a fixed target
tdee.applyHint: Switches the phase to fixed-kcal mode with this value.
